name: CBDT ITR-1 Validation Rules AY 2024-25 (v1.0)
description: Generated from the CBDT ITR-1 AY2024-25 validation-rules document. 301 rules (289 written for this form, 12 carried over from itr2-ay2024-25). Category A → error, Category B/D → warning.

rules.name: Tax has been computed although gross total income is nil
rules.notes: Read as: tax payable on total income (D1) can only be non-zero when gross total income (B4) is positive; the "all heads > 0" wording cannot be meant literally (a salaried filer has no HP/OS income). GTI is schema-mandatory, so the exists() guard only keeps the rule quiet on a partial document.

rules.name: Income details must be disclosed when taxes paid are claimed
rules.notes: Tax computation (Part D) is mandatory in the schema, so only the income side is checked: at least one head or the GTI must be filled when total taxes paid (D10) is positive.

rules.name: Old regime: rebate u/s 87A not available when total income exceeds Rs 5,00,000
Old regime: rebate u/s 87A cannot exceed Rs 12,500 (nor the tax payable)
rules.notes: The rebate is also capped at the tax payable on total income (D1) since it cannot create a negative tax.

rules.name: New regime: rebate u/s 87A above Rs 7,00,000 limited to marginal relief (tax − excess income over 7 lakh)
rules.notes: Marginal rebate (proviso to s.87A): when total income exceeds 7 lakh the rebate cannot exceed tax payable minus the excess of income over 7 lakh; beyond ~7.28 lakh this forces the rebate to zero.

rules.name: New regime: rebate u/s 87A cannot exceed Rs 25,000 (nor the tax payable)
Tax after rebate (D3) = tax payable on total income (D1) − rebate u/s 87A (D2)
Total tax and cess (D5) = tax after rebate (D3) + health & education cess (D4)
Health & education cess (D4) = 4% of tax after rebate (D3)
rules.notes: Derived from the form: ITR-1 has no surcharge, so cess is 4% of D3 (±1 for rounding).

rules.name: Total tax, fee and interest (D9) = D5 + 234A + 234B + 234C + 234F − relief u/s 89 (D6)
Total interest and fee payable (D8) = 234A + 234B + 234C + 234F
Total tax, fee and interest (D9) = balance tax after relief (D7) + total interest and fee (D8)
Balance tax after relief (D7) = total tax and cess (D5) − relief u/s 89 (D6)
rules.notes: Derived from the form arithmetic; together with Sl. 15 and Sl. 66 this keeps D5–D9 consistent.

rules.name: Relief u/s 89 cannot be claimed without salary u/s 17(1)/17(2)/17(3) or family pension
rules.notes: Family pension = other-sources dropdown row with nature FAP.

rules.name: Old regime: tax payable on total income (D1) must follow the slab rates (basic exemption 2.5 / 3 / 5 lakh by age)

rhs.expression: round(if(ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome <= if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1944-04-01", 500000, if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1964-04-01", 300000, 250000)), 0, if(ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome <= 500000, 0.05 * (ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome - if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1944-04-01", 500000, if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1964-04-01", 300000, 250000))), if(ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome <= 1000000, 0.05 * (500000 - if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1944-04-01", 500000, if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1964-04-01", 300000, 250000))) + 0.2 * (ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome - 500000), 0.05 * (500000 - if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1944-04-01", 500000, if(ITR.ITR1.PersonalInfo.DOB <= "1964-04-01", 300000, 250000))) + 100000 + 0.3 * (ITR.ITR1.ITR1_IncomeDeductions.TotalIncome - 1000000)))))

rules.notes: Senior (60+) = DOB on or before 1964-04-01, super senior (80+) = DOB on or before 1944-04-01. ±10 tolerance for rounding u/s 288A/288B; warning because agricultural income for rate purposes is not modelled (ITR-1 allows ≤ Rs 5,000 which does not trigger it).

rules.name: New regime (115BAC): tax payable on total income (D1) must follow the slab rates (0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30%)
rules.notes: Slabs: 3–6 lakh 5%, 6–9 lakh 10%, 9–12 lakh 15%, 12–15 lakh 20%, above 15 lakh 30%; ±10 tolerance for rounding.

rules.name: Refund (D12) = total taxes paid (D10) − total tax, fee and interest (D9), when positive
